market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have been a top-4 fixture, finishing inside the top four in 7 of the last 8 EPL seasons. They possess a deep, talented squad and their new manager Arne Slot has built on Jürgen Klopp's successful foundation. While aging stars like Salah and Van Dijk, plus possible squad turnover, introduce some risk, I still estimate a 60% chance of another top-four finish—above the market's implied 52.5% probability, making 'Yes' undervalued.
evidence_points: Finished top 4 in 7 of last 8 seasons, including 3rd in 2023-24.
Squad includes world-class players like Salah, Van Dijk, Alexander-Arnold, and emerging talents.
Managerial transition to Arne Slot has so far maintained competitive standards.
sources_consulted: Current Liverpool squad composition and contract situations
